section.label: Specialist area
welding.title: Welding technology
welding.intro: Digital specialist applications support the structured assessment of welds. Complementary articles explain technical failures, quality assurance processes and transferable lessons for design, fabrication and inspection.
applications.label: Specialist applications
applications.intro: Interactive tools guide users through measurement entry, plausibility checks, assessment and documented presentation of results.
butt.title: Butt weld assessment
butt.description: Guided assessment of imperfections in butt welds in accordance with DIN EN ISO 5817:2023. The application combines measurement entry, plausibility checks, an optional comparison with the 2014 edition and a generated inspection report.
fillet.title: Fillet weld assessment
fillet.description: Guided assessment of fillet welds in accordance with DIN EN ISO 5817:2023. Measurements, geometric plausibility and relevant inspection criteria are brought together in a transparent workflow and prepared for the report.
articles.label: Technical articles
articles.weldingIntro: Technical case studies with reliable sources, clear context and practical professional value.
qa.title: When complete documentation creates false confidence
qa.description: The collapse at Kew Recreation Centre shows why a complete QA package does not prove that documentation and fabrication match. The article explains how drawings, WPSs, qualifications, inspection plans and reports must be verified for the actual component – relevant to welding coordination, fabrication, inspection, procurement and technical project responsibility.
bolting.title: Bolting technology
bolting.intro: Articles on bolts, threads and structural connections show how load paths, assembly changes, local stresses and technical approvals determine structural safety.
articles.boltingIntro: Practice-oriented analyses of connection failures and design changes for design engineers, structural engineers, workshop planning, assembly and technical responsibility.
hyatt.title: Why a small change had tragic consequences
hyatt.description: This technical case study of the Hyatt Regency collapse examines a modified hanger-rod and nut connection. It explains the changed load path, local overloading of the box beam, the failure mechanism and professional consequences – with particular value for design, structural engineering, workshop planning, assembly and the approval of changes.
